                                                                                                                 Introduction
                                                                                                             SINUMERIK CNCs
                                                                                                                    SINUMERIK 828

■ Overview
                                                                                                                                          1
  SINUMERIK 828D – the powerhouse among
  the compact CNCs
  With their unique CNC performance, SINUMERIK 828D CNCs
  set productivity benchmarks when it comes to milling and turn-
  ing on standard machines as well as functions for easy automa-
  tion of grinding machines. New SINAMICS drives and SIMOTICS
  Motion Control motors make the SINUMERIK 828D even more
  productive.
  Rugged and maintenance-free
  An operator panel front of die-cast magnesium, the panel-based
  CNC design with minimal interfaces and the high degree of pro-
  tection on the front of the PPU make the SINUMERIK 828D CNCs
  reliable partners even in harsh environments. Designed without
  a fan or hard disk, with NVRAM memory technology and no
  back-up battery, SINUMERIK 828D CNCs are completely
  maintenance-free.                                                 Technology tailor-made for use in standard turning and
  User-friendly                                                     milling machines

  lution 12.1" TFT color display or 15.6" touch display.            technology. With two preconfigured system software variants for

  CNC data are quickly and simply transferred via the USB 3.1       ready for use in turning and milling machines on dispatch from

      Introduction
      SINAMICS S120/S220 drive system


1   ■ Overview
                                                                         The rugged drive class for compact machine concepts
                                                                         The SINAMICS S120 Combi drive system offers the usual
                                                                         SINAMICS functionality in a multi-axis drive module tailored for
                                                                         compact turning and milling machines. Featuring a host of tech-
                                                                         nical highlights, the SINAMICS S120 Combi sets new standards
                                                                         in this drive class.
                                                                         SINAMICS S120 Combi integrates a line infeed with regenera-
                                                                         tive feedback capability as well as 3 or 4 Motor Modules for
                                                                         spindle and feed motors in one Power Module. The power spec-
                                                                         trum extends up to 16 kW spindle power (S1) and up to 12 A cur-
                                                                         rent (S1) for feed motors.
                                                                         SINAMICS S120 Combi thus covers the typical range of power
                                                                         ratings of compact standard turning and milling machines and is
                                                                         the perfect drive partner for the SINUMERIK 828D CNCs.
                                                                         The solution for machines with more axes and
                                                                         higher power ratings
                                                                         The SINAMICS Combi Power Module frame type Bxx can be ex-
      SINAMICS S120 Combi Power Module, frame type Bxx
                                                                         tended by the SINAMICS S120 Motor Modules in booksize for-
                                                                         mat if the machine has more axes. This application is supported
                                                                         by the CNC software from V4.95 onwards.
                                                                         For machine concepts beyond the performance limit of the
                                                                         SINAMICS S120 Combi, the SINAMICS S120/S220 modular
                                                                         drive system is available as an alternative to the
                                                                         SINUMERIK 828D CNCs.
                                                                         With SINAMICS S220 Booksize, Siemens is enhancing the
                                                                         proven SINAMICS S120 series with considerably more powerful
                                                                         functions and is providing answers to future requirements.
                                                                         SINAMICS S220 is the reliable, robust, and innovative high-per-
                                                                         formance solution that meets all the requirements with regard to
                                                                         IoT and industrial cybersecurity.
                                                                         SINAMICS S220 Smart Line Modules are the first steps in inno-
                                                                         vating the proven SINAMICS S120 range. Smart Line Modules
                                                                         are an integral part of the SINAMICS S220 Booksize series and
                                                                         are characterized by the highest level of performance, maximum
                                                                         flexibility, high degree of user-friendliness and their fit for digita-
                                                                         lization. Available in two versions (C and D type). Their higher
      SINAMICS S220 Double Motor Module in booksize format C/D type      power density, greater overload capability, and precise dimen-
                                                                         sioning mean that economical machine solutions can be imple-
                                                                         mented, while also requiring less space in the control cabinet.
                                                                         Thanks to their innovative mechanical design, Smart Line
                                                                         Modules are also simple and reliable to install and extremely
                                                                         robust.
                                                                         Operation of SINAMICS S220 Smart Line Modules is possible
                                                                         with a CU320-2 Control Unit
                                                                         (as of SINAMICS firmware V5.2 SP3 HF10).
                                                                         Smart Line Modules can supply energy and return regenerative
                                                                         energy to the supply system. Braking Modules and braking re-
                                                                         sistors are required only if the drives need to be decelerated in
                                                                         a controlled manner after a power failure – i.e. when energy can-
                                                                         not be regenerated into the line supply. When a Smart Line
                                                                         Module is used as the infeed, the matching line reactor must be
                                                                         installed. A line filter can be optionally installed in order to ensure
                                                                         compliance with the limits stipulated for Category C2 in
                                                                         EN 61800-3.
                                                                         TIA Selection Tool
      SINAMICS S220 Smart Line Module, in booksize format
                                                                         The TIA Selection Tool is available for optimum configuration and
                                                                         planning of projects. It supports users in selecting and assem-
                                                                         bling automation components – regardless of their experience
                                                                         level. No detailed portfolio knowledge is necessary. The tool is
                                                                         available both as a free desktop version and as a cloud variant.
                                                                         www.siemens.com/tia-selection-tool

      Introduction
      SIMOTICS motors


1   ■ Overview




      SIMOTICS T-1FW6 torque motors
      The torque motors satisfy the most exacting demands in preci-
      sion, performance and dynamic response. Permanent-magnet
      synchronous motors with a high number of poles are fully inte-
      grated in the machine, and mechanical transmission elements
      such as gearboxes, for example, are omitted, so you benefit
      from greater flexibility with regard to installation, easier servicing,
      higher availability and minimal space requirements.




                                                                                SIMOTICS M-1FE1/1FE2 built-in motors
                                                                                SIMOTICS M-1FE built-in motors are suitable for the greatest de-
                                                                                mands for machining quality, precision, and smooth running. De-
                                                                                pending on the application, built-in motors are available in a
                                                                                High Torque or High Speed version. Built-in motors are high-per-
                                                                                formance motor spindles that are used in machine tools with ap-
                                                                                plications for short acceleration times and high speeds.
                                                                                SINAMICS and SIMOTICS
                                                                                In combination with the SINAMICS S120/S220 drive systems, the
                                                                                SIMOTICS motors for motion control form a highly dynamic and
                                                                                powerful drive system with outstanding performance – perfectly
      SIMOTICS L-1FN3 linear motors                                             matched to one another.
      SIMOTICS L-1FN3 motors are linear drives in compact design                We can also provide customized solutions
      with a high power/force density. They are characterized by non-
      wearing power transmission. SIMOTICS L-1FN3 motors meet the               In addition to the range of motors described, we offer a compre-
      greatest demands for dynamic response, contour precision, and             hensive range of solutions for feed and spindle applications.
      accuracy, and are optimized for operation on high-performance             Your Siemens sales representative will be happy to advise you
      machine tools.                                                            on how to configure your individual equipment.

      Introduction
      MACHINUM


1   ■ Overview
                                                                            Higher productivity in engineering
                                                                            Numerous applications help make the mechanical and electrical
                                                                            development of your machines more efficient and optimize the
                                                                            production process.
                                                                            Efficient production through digital production planning
                                                                            Tools and NC code are valuable resources. Your digital adminis-
                                                                            tration in one software that is linked with the machine control sys-
                                                                            tems, minimizes errors, optimizes setup processes and ensures
                                                                            smooth production. This means production always has timely
                                                                            access to all essential programs and tools.
                                                                            Increased efficiency in manufacturing
                                                                            Digitalization enables machine users to ensure the production of
                                                                            high-quality parts and simultaneously increases the productivity
                                                                            of the machine and lowers the production costs.
                                                                            Increase productivity with the digital twin
      MACHINUM is the digitalization portfolio based on Siemens
      Xcelerator designed to elevate productivity and sustainability in     Programming can be carried out efficiently away from produc-
      part manufacturing. MACHINUM comprises software products              tion through the virtual representation of the machine. This mini-
      to transfer tasks from the real to the virtual machine, to lift the   mizes setup times, optimizes machining processes and fully ex-
      productivity of individual machines and to increase transpar-         ploits machine capacity – without any interruptions during
      ency of the entire machine shopfloor.                                 operation.
      Using innovative technologies and software makes it easy for          Automatic feedrate adaptation for optimized machining
      MACHINUM to analyze processes, capture production data and
                                                                            Adaptive feedrate control and tool monitoring adapt machining
      make better use of production capacity.
                                                                            to changing conditions in real time. This makes processes such
                                                                            as milling, grinding and turning more efficient, while protecting
                                                                            tools and improving product quality.

      Introduction
      Drive Based Safety Integrated


1   ■ Overview                                                            ■ Application
                                                                            For the CNC axes of the SINUMERIK 828D, both the Safety Inte-
                                                                            grated basic functions (STO, SS1, SBC) and the extended
                                                                            Safety Integrated functions of SINAMICS can be used. The
                                                                            Safety Integrated basic functions are directly controlled via ter-
                                                                            minals. A SINAMICS S120 TM54F Terminal Module is required
                                                                            for controlling the extended Safety Integrated functions.
                                                                            For simple positioning tasks, e.g. revolvers, loading systems or
                                                                            tool magazines that require no coordination with the CNC part
                                                                            program, it is possible to connect two auxiliary axes to the
                                                                            SINUMERIK 828D via the I/O interface based on PROFINET
                                                                            using a SINAMICS S120 CU310-2 PN or CU320-2 PN.
                                                                            The Safety Integrated basic functions of the SINAMICS system
                                                                            can be utilized for these CNC auxiliary axes. The Safety Inte-
                                                                            grated basic functions are selected by hardware and in
                                                                            2 channels via terminals on the CU310-2 PN/CU320-2 PN and
                                                                            the Motor Module.
                                                                            A partially automated acceptance test is provided in
                                                                            SINUMERIK Operate for acceptance testing Safety Integrated
                                                                            functions. All measured data and traces are logged and can be
      SINUMERIK Safety Integrated ensures safe work, for example            printed out in an acceptance report.

                                                                        ■ More information
  The basic functions of Safety Integrated are activated via the ter-
  minals of the SINAMICS S120 Combi Power Modules or the                  For further information about standards, SINUMERIK Safety Inte-
  SINAMICS S120/S220 Motor Modules and SINUMERIK 828D.                    grated functions and safety function calculations, see:
  Extended Safety Integrated functions (option):                          support.industry.siemens.com/cs/document/109478083
  • Safe Torque Off (STO)
    Suppression of drive pulses, providing safe electronic inter-
    ruption of the energy supply
  • Safe Stop 1 (SS1) time-controlled or speed-controlled
    Safe shutdown of a drive, with subsequent transition into the
    STO state
  • Safe Stop 2 (SS2)
    Safe stopping of the drive with subsequent monitoring for
    standstill (SOS)
  • Safe Operating Stop (SOS)
    Monitors drives for standstill – the drives remain fully func-
    tional in the position control
  • Safely-Limited Speed (SLS)
    Monitoring of 4 configurable velocity limit values,
    e.g. during setup
  • Safe Acceleration Monitor (SAM) / Safe Brake Ramp (SBR)
    Safe monitoring of the braking process
  • Safe Speed Monitor (SSM)
    Safe checkback signal when a value falls below a settable
    speed limit, e.g. for enabling a protective door
  • Safely-Limited Position (SLP)
    Switchable traversing range limitation (2 ranges)
  • Safe Direction (SDI)
    Safe monitoring of the direction of motion
  • Safe Brake Management (SBM)
    - Safe Brake Control (SBC)
      2-channel braking signal – integrated in the SINAMICS S120
      Motor Module
    - Safe Brake Test (SBT)  Diagnostics function
      Cyclic brake test
  The extended Safety Integrated functions require a software
  license in the form of a CNC option per axis/spindle with Safety
  functions. A SINAMICS TM54F Terminal Module is required for
  controlling the extended Safety Integrated functions.
  Commissioning support:
  • Graphical commissioning with SINUMERIK Operate
    For each Safety function there is a clear, graphical display
    available for fast commissioning
  • Integrated acceptance test with SINUMERIK Operate
    Partially automated acceptance test for all safety-related func-
    tions. Simple operation of the test process, automatic config-
    uration of trace functions and automatic generation of an ac-
    ceptance record.

      5 steps toward higher energy efficiency
      Exploit the full potential of energy efficiency in your production

      customers.
      To achieve this, as a leading technology partner, we accompany

                                                                                                         SINUMERIK CNCs
                                                                                                        SINUMERIK Operate
                                                                               The user interface for efficient machine operation

■ Overview
  SINUMERIK Operate – perfect for all programming tasks
  With various programming methods, SINUMERIK supports all worldwide promoted CNC programming methods – from single part
  production to mass production.
  For mass production ...
  Shortest machining times for mass production combined with
  the greatest degree of flexibility for special applications:
  SINUMERIK CNCs make this possible with advanced CNC pro-
  gramming with high-level language elements. With pro-
  gramGUIDE, SINUMERIK CNC programs can be easily com-
  bined with powerful technology and measuring cycles. Even
                                                                                                                                    3
  classic ISO codes can be programmed. This makes SINUMERIK
  especially attractive to operators who prefer this classic type of
  program.




  ... and small series
  The programming times is a crucial productivity factor for small
  series and single parts. ShopMill and ShopTurn machining step
  programming is unbeatable in these fields. Processes such as
  drilling, centering, plunging and pocket milling are represented
  as machining steps. In this way, CNC programs are extremely
  compact and easily read, even for complex machining opera-
  tions. All geometric elements in a CNC program are shown to
  scale thanks to the dynamic broken-line graphics, the only one
  of its kind on the market.




  Process safety through CNC simulation
  SINUMERIK CNC simulation guarantees maximum process
  safety by using the real geometries of the loaded tools. Of
  course the simulation displays an exact image of the desired
  machining – not just brilliant 3D representations. SINUMERIK
  CNC simulation simulates every type of machining, such as face
  and cylinder surfaces, swiveled workpiece planes or even ma-
  chining in multiple machining channels. Even very large part
  programs can be displayed on screen within seconds with the
  Quickview for mold-making.

  The operator panels are predominantly used for visualization

  machines.

                                                                                                                  SIMATIC PN/PN coupler

■ Overview                                                         ■ Function
                                                                     The SIMATIC PN/PN coupler provides the output data of the writ-
                                                                     ing CPU as input data to the receiving CPUs within a PN cycle.
                                                                     Both fail-safe data (via F_SendDP/F_ReceiveDP of a
                                                                     SIMATIC F-CPU only) and standard data can be transmitted.
                                                                     2 basically different methods are available for data transmission:
                                                                     • Data exchange via virtual I/O modules (coupling modules)
                                                                     • Data record transfer
                                                                     The PN/PN coupler provides extensive diagnostic information
                                                                     about LEDs, interrupts and status bytes. In this way, errors can
                                                                     be quickly located and commissioning and downtimes mini-                   3
                                                                     mized.
                                                                     The PN/PN coupler supports a variety of SIMATIC bus adapters
                                                                     for flexible connection to PROFINET.

    ■ Overview                                                             ■ Benefits
                                                                             • High efficiency

                                                                             • Narrow width and easy installation

3                                                                          ■ More information

      The 24 V power supply units from the SITOP range are optimized
      for industrial use and operate on the switched-mode principle.
      Due to the precisely regulated output voltage, the devices are
      even suitable for the connection of sensitive sensors. Different
      versions are available depending on the output current and field
      of application.
      SITOP does not require much space on the standard mounting
      rail and offers a high level of functionality. Thanks to the extra
      power, 1.5 times the rated current for 5 seconds, large loads can
      also be switched on without any problems.

    ■ Overview                                                             ■ Design
                                                                             The Active Line Modules in booksize format feature the following
                                                                             connections and interfaces as standard:
                                                                             • 1 power connection via screw-type terminals
                                                                             • 1 connection for the 24 V DC electronics power supply via the
                                                                               24 V terminal adapter included in the scope of supply
                                                                             • 1 DC link connection via integrated DC link busbars
                                                                             • 3 DRIVE-CLiQ sockets
                                                                             • 2 PE (protective earth) connections
                                                                             • 1 temperature sensor input for KTY84-130, Pt1000 or PTC
                                                                               (Pt1000 can be used from firmware V4.7 HF17)
                                                                             The status of the Active Line Modules is indicated via two multi-
                                                                             color LEDs.
                                                                             For the Active Line Module with a width of 100 mm (3.94 in), the
4                                                                            shield of the power connection cable can be connected to the
                                                                             integrated shield connection plate by means of a shield connec-
                                                                             tion clamp or hose clip, e.g. Weidmüller type KLBÜ CO 4. The
                                                                             shield connection clamp must not be used as a strain relief
                                                                             mechanism. Shield connection sets are available for the 150 mm
                                                                             (5.91 in), 200 mm (7.87 in) and 300 mm (11.81 in) wide Active
                                                                             Line Modules.
                                                                             The signal cable shield can be connected to the Active Line
                                                                             Module by means of a shield connection clamp, e.g. Weidmüller
                                                                             type KLBÜ 3-8 SC.

      Active Interface Modules for 16 kW, 36 kW, 55 kW and 80 kW/120 kW        Separate Active Interface Module

      The Active Interface Modules combine with the Active Line Mod-
                                                                                                             (1)       DRIVE-CLiQ
      ules to form a functional unit and are required for operation of the
      associated Active Line Module. The Active Interface Modules                                            (2)
      contain a Clean Power Filter and basic interference suppression
      to ensure compliance with Category C3 in accordance with
      EN 61800-3 with respect to emitted interference.
      The Clean Power Filter protects the mains connection from
      switching-frequency harmonics. The drive system therefore                                                                   ...
      draws a sinusoidal current from the supply and causes almost
      no harmonics.

4

      Basic Line Filter
      Basic Line Filters are used on machines on which conducted
      interference emissions in the frequency range between 150 kHz
      and 30 MHz need to be damped in accordance with the require-
      ments of CE-EMC legislation.
      With the Basic Line Filters in combination with the Active
      Interface Modules, the limits for the interference voltages can be
      extended to Category C2 (EN 61800-3) or, retaining Category
      C3, longer total cable lengths are possible for the configuration.

4
      In plants with strict EMC requirements, line filters work together
      with line reactors to restrict the conducted interference emanat-
      ing from the power modules to the limit values of Class A1 as de-
      fined in EN 55011 and Category C2 as defined in EN 61800-3.
      The line filters are suitable for TN and TT supply systems
      grounded at the neutral point.
      The use of other makes of line reactor can lead to malfunctions
      or irreparable damage to equipment.

      System overview

    ■ Overview                                                               Smart Line Modules
                                                                             Smart Line Modules can supply energy and return regenerative
                                                                             energy to the supply system. A Braking Module and braking re-
                                                                             sistor are required only if the drives need to be decelerated in a
                                                                             controlled manner after a power failure (i.e. when energy cannot
                                                                             be recovered to the supply). When a Smart Line Module is used
                                                                             as the infeed, the matching line reactor must be installed. A line
                                                                             filter can be optionally installed in order to ensure compliance
                                                                             with the limits stipulated for Category C2 in EN 61800-3.

                                                                                                                                                        4
  Line reactors are always to be provided for operation of Smart
  Line Modules, as line harmonics can occur on converters that
  damage/disturb other loads connected to the same line supply.
  Line reactors limit the line harmonics to permissible values.Line
  reactors that are not permissible can damage the Smart Line
  Modules.

■ Overview
                                                                                                              A Motor Module is a power unit (inverter). It generates a variable
                                                                                                              voltage with variable frequency from the DC link voltage that
                                                                                                              feeds the connected motor(s).

  Overview of Double Motor Module in booksize format C/D types
  • C type: Optimized for continuous load with up to 200 % over-
    load (continuous motion)
  • D type: Optimized for highly dynamic, intermittent duty cycles
    with up to 300 % overload (discontinuous motion)
  Devices in booksize format C/D types are optimized for multi-
  axis applications and are mounted next to one another. The con-
  nection for the common DC link is an integral feature. The device
  is internally air cooled.
  The Motor Modules in booksize format C/D types are a further
  development of the booksize series and offer the following ad-
  vantages:
  • The amount of space required beneath the Motor Modules has
    been reduced thanks to improvements in the design.
  • In the motor plug connector, the brake conductors and the PE
    connection are integrated directly in the plug connector.
  • The motor connections on the Double Motor Module are lo-
    cated side by side, resulting in a significantly improved level
    of accessibility.
  • The fan can be simply replaced without having to remove the
    Motor Module.
  • The Double Motor Module 2 x 18 A is available with double
    and treble overload as well as in an extra slim variant with a
    width of 50 mm (1.97 in).
  The signal cable shield can be connected to the Motor Module
  by means of a shield connection clamp, e.g. Weidmüller type
  KLBUE 3-8 SC.

      SIMOTICS S-1FT2 Compact synchronous motors – Natural cooling

    ■ Overview                                                              ■ Application
                                                                              • Machine tools (e.g. auxiliary axes, feed drives)
                                                                              • Robots and handling systems
                                                                              • Packaging, plastics and textile machines
                                                                              • Wood, glass, ceramics and stone working machines

                                                                            ■ Function
                                                                              • Compact synchronous servomotors

                                                                           Motion Control Encoder measuring systems
                                                                                  Built-on optoelectronic rotary encoders
                                                                                                                            Introduction

■ Overview                                                             ■ Design
                                                                         All motion control encoders are available in Synchro flange and
                                                                         clamp flange versions. The absolute encoders are also available
                                                                         with a hollow shaft and torque arm.
                                                                         The motion control encoders are driven via a plug-in coupling or
                                                                         spring disk coupling. Alternatively, pulleys can also be used.
                                                                         The motor control encoder supply voltage is 5 V DC or alterna-
                                                                         tively 10 V to 30 V DC. The 10 V to 30 V DC version supports
                                                                         longer cable lengths. Most control systems supply the voltage
                                                                         directly at the measuring circuit connector. With SINAMICS, the
                                                                         measuring systems are provided with power via the Sensor
                                                                         Modules.
                                                                         For motion control encoders with cables, the cable length in-
                                                                         cluding the connector is 1 m (3.28 ft).
                                                                         The following bending radii must be observed for the cable to
                                                                         the built-on encoder:
  Incremental and absolute encoders with mounting accessories            • One-time bending:  20 mm (0.79 in)
                                                                         • Continuous bending:  75 mm (2.95 in)
  Motion control encoders are optoelectronic built-on encoders
  that detect the traversing distances, angles of rotation, speeds
  or positions of machine axes. Motion control encoders are direct     ■ More information
  measuring systems that are built-on to shafts, axes or motors.
  They can be used in conjunction with numerical and program-            Power supply
  mable logic controllers, drives and position displays. Motion          Absolute encoders with EnDat, SSI or DRIVE-CLiQ and
  control encoders are system-tested, certified components that          incremental encoders with sin/cos 1 Vpp, HTL or TTL fulfill the
  have been harmonized for use with the following systems:               requirements of IEC 61010-1 if power is supplied from a
  • SINUMERIK CNCs                                                       secondary circuit with limited energy (Low Voltage, Limited
                                                                         Energy) acc. to IEC 61010-13rd Ed., Section 9.4 or from a
  • SIMOTION Motion Control Systems
  • SIMATIC programmable logic controllers
                                                                         Class 2 secondary circuit in accordance with UL 1310.              6
                                                                         The corresponding sections of DIN EN 61010-1, EN 61010-1,
  • SINAMICS drive systems                                               UL 61010-1 and CAN/CSA-C22.2 No. 61010-1 can be used
                                                                         instead of IEC 61010-13rd Ed., Section 9.4.
■ Application                                                            Absolute encoders with PROFIBUS DP and PROFINET IO fulfill
  Motion control encoders are used with machine tools and pro-           the requirements of UL 508 and CAN/CSA-C22.2 No. 14 if power
  duction machines as additional external measuring systems.             is supplied from a Class 2 secondary circuit as per National
  They are available as incremental or absolute encoders.                Electrical Code/Canadian Electrical Code.
  Incremental encoders
  In the case of incremental encoders, the machine must travel to a
  reference point after each power-off state, as the position is not
  usually stored in the controller. Movements of the machine while
  the power is off are not recorded.
  Incremental encoders are suitable for use in simple machine
  concepts with mostly small dimensions.
  Absolute encoders
  Absolute encoders, on the other hand, also record movements
  while the power is off and return the actual position after power
  on. Travel to a reference point is not necessary.
  Absolute encoders are suitable for complex machines or
  machines with large dimensions.

      Motion Control Encoder measuring systems
      Built-on optoelectronic rotary encoders
      Incremental encoders

    ■ Function
                                                                                        The encoder electronics amplify these signals and convert them
                                                                                        to different output levels.
                                                                                        Signal levels
                                                                                        The following signal levels are available for the incremental
                                                                                        encoders:
                                                                                         Signal level               Benefits
                                                                                         Analog signals sin/cos     The analog signal allows the digitization of the
                                                                                         with level 1 Vpp           trace signals. In order to obtain a fine resolution,
                                                                                                                    the signals are interpolated in the higher-level
                                                                                                                    controller.
                                                                                         RS422 differential signals The resolution can be quadrupled by means of
                                                                                         (TTL)                      edge evaluation.
      Incremental encoder with sin/cos 1 Vpp and clamp flange incl. cable with
                                                                                         HTL (High Voltage          Built-on encoders with an HTL interface are
      connector as well as incremental encoder with RS422/HTL and Synchro
                                                                                         Transistor Logic)          designed for applications with digital inputs with
      flange                                                                                                        a 24 V level. The resolution can be quadrupled
      Incremental encoders detect relative movement and deliver a                                                   by means of edge evaluation.
      defined number of electrical pulses per revolution, which repre-
      sent the measurement of the traveled distance or angle.
      Incremental encoders operate on the principle of optoelectronic
      scanning of dividing discs with the transmitted light principle. The
      light source is a light emitting diode (LED). The light-dark modula-
      tion generated as the encoder shaft rotates is picked up by pho-
      toelectronic elements. With an appropriate arrangement of the line
      pattern on the dividing disk connected to the shaft and the fixed
      aperture, the photoelectronic elements provide two trace signals
      A and B at 90° to one another, as well as a reference signal R.

                                                                                             • Advantages in time-critical applications

  DRIVE-CLiQ and PROFINET IO (bottom)                                                        • Reduced wiring overhead in plants with a large

  0° and 360°. They operate on the same scanning principle as

  incremental encoders, but have a greater number of tracks. For
  example, if there are 13 tracks, then 213 = 8192 steps are coded                           • Reduced wiring overhead in plants with a large
                                                                                               number of encoders
  in the case of single-turn encoders. The code used is a one-step
  code (gray code). This prevents any scanning errors from occur-                            • Supports conformity class C (IRT communication),
                                                                                               B, A (RT communication)
  ring. After switching on the machine, the position value is trans-
  ferred immediately to the controller, travel to a reference point is                       • IRT (isochronous mode)
  not necessary.                                                                             • 2 ports

  All absolute encoders are available in single-turn and multi-turn
  versions.
  Single-turn encoders                                                                                            n×T
  Single-turn encoders divide one rotation (360 degrees mechan-
                                                                                          tcal              T
  ical) into a specific number of steps, e.g. 8192. A unique code
  word is assigned to each position. After 360° the position values
  are repeated.
  Multi-turn encoders

  Multi-turn encoders record the number of revolutions in addition
  to the absolute position within one revolution. To do this, further
  code discs which are coupled via gear steps with the encoder                                          n   n-1    n-2   2     1
  shaft are scanned. When evaluating 12 additional tracks, this

                                                                                       Motion Control Encoder measuring systems
                                                                                              Built-on optoelectronic rotary encoders
                                                                                                                                                      Accessories

■ Overview
                                                                                     Signal connectors as mating connectors
                                                                                     A signal connector is available as a mating connector for motion
                                                                                     control encoders with flange outlet or with cable and connector.
                                                                                     The mating connector with 12 contacts is suitable for all incre-
                                                                                     mental encoders.
                                                                                     The mating connector with 17 contacts is suitable for absolute
                                                                                     encoders with EnDat.
                                                                                     Signal connector
                                                                                     A signal connector is available as a replacement for motion
                                                                                     control encoders with cable and connector.
                                                                                     MOTION-CONNECT DRIVE-CLiQ signal cables
                                                                                     Pre-assembled MOTION-CONNECT DRIVE-CLiQ signal cables
                                                                                     with M12 plug are available as basic cables and extensions for
  Couplings and clamps                                                               connecting motion control encoders with DRIVE-CLiQ interface.

  Couplings                                                                          For further information about the signal cables, refer to
                                                                                     “MOTION-CONNECT connection systems”.
  The motion control encoders are driven via a plug-in coupling or
  spring disk coupling. Alternatively, pulleys can also be used.
  Clamps
  Motion control encoders with Synchro flange can be axially
  mounted on the machine with screws or secured with 3 clamps.

      MOTION-CONNECT connection systems
      Introduction
      General information

    ■ Overview                                                                        ■ Function
      MOTION-CONNECT cables are suitable for use with many
      different types of machine tools and production machinery.
      The following variants of MOTION-CONNECT cable are avail-
      able as fully-assembled power and signal cables or sold by the


                                                                                                                                                          G_NC01_XX_00289
      meter:
      • MOTION-CONNECT 500
        - Cost-effective solution for predominantly fixed installation
        - Suitable for low mechanical loading
        - Tested for travel distances of up to 5 m
      • MOTION-CONNECT 800PLUS
        - Meets requirements for use in cable carriers
        - Suitable for high mechanical loading
        - Oil resistance                                                                The cables must be removed from the drum without twisting, i.e.
        - Tested for travel distances of up to 50 m                                     the cables must be unwound and must never be lifted over the
                                                                                        drum flange in loops.
    ■ Benefits
      Pre-assembled MOTION-CONNECT cables provide high quality
      and perfect, system-tested functionality.
      SPEED-CONNECT
      Connectors with SPEED-CONNECT quick-release locks enable
      fast, stable and reliable connections. Less than a quarter revolu-
      tion of the union nut of the connector already provides reliable
      locking and therefore a reliable connection, completely without
      tools.                                                                                                                                  G_NC01_XX_00291

      The cables with SPEED-CONNECT connectors supplement the
      established range of MOTION-CONNECT cables with full-thread
      connectors.                                                                       To maximize the service life of the cable carrier and cables,
                                                                                        cables in the carrier made from different materials must be
    ■ Application                                                                       separated by spacers in the cable carrier. The spacers must be
                                                                                        filled evenly to ensure that the position of the cables does not
      MOTION-CONNECT cables are intended for use in machines.                           change during operation. The cables should be distributed as
      They are not suitable for building technology applications or                     symmetrically as possible according to their weights and dimen-
7     outdoor installation.                                                             sions. Cables with very different outer diameters should also be
                                                                                        separated by spacers.
      MOTION-CONNECT cables are tested in a cable carrier with
      horizontal travel distance and are also designed for cable carrier                When inserting pre-assembled cables into the cable carrier, do
      installation. They are not self-supporting.                                       not pull at the connector, as this may damage the strain relief or
                                                                                        cable clamping.
      The pre-assembled cables can be ordered in length units of
      10 cm and can be extended, if necessary.                                          The cables must not be fixed in the cable carrier. They must be
                                                                                        freely movable.
      When cable lengths (basic cables and extensions) are deter-
      mined for the systems and applications described in this
      catalog, the technically permissible maximum cable lengths
      (e.g. 25 m) specified in the catalog must be observed.
      Malfunctions can occur if longer cables are used.
      Siemens assumes no liability for correct transmission of
      signals or power in this case.
      Compatibility between SPEED-CONNECT and full-thread
      connectors:

  Power cable for connecting a SIMOTICS S-1FK7 motor with
  SPEED-CONNECT connector to a SINAMICS S120 Combi Power Module
  The synchronous and asynchronous motors are connected to
  the Motor Modules or Power Modules by means of
  MOTION-CONNECT power cables.
  The pre-assembled MOTION-CONNECT power cables are of
  high quality and offer safety with problem-free functioning.
  If pre-assembled power cables are to be installed in a cable car-
  rier in such a way that the connector would inhibit assembly, pre-
  assembled cables without assembled connector can also be
  supplied. In this case, the contacts of the cables are crimped
  and the connector is supplied separately. After installing the ca-
  bles, the customer assembles the connector.                                                                                                  7
  The 6FX.002-5....-.... power cables are available with crimped
  contacts and with the connector supplied separately as an op-
  tion (not applicable to power cables with bare wire ends or cable
  lugs).
  Power cables with separately supplied module-end connector:
  In this case, the 6th position of the Article No. must be changed
  from 0 to 1: 6FX.012-5....-.... (not for power cables for SINAMICS
  S120 Power Modules).
  Power cables without module-end connector:
  In this case, the 6th position of the Article No. must be changed
  from 0 to 2: 6FX.022-5....-....
  The connector can be ordered separately.
  Power cables with separately supplied motor-end connector:
  In this case, the 6th position of the Article No. must be changed
  from 0 to 4: 6FX.042-5....-.... (not for power cables with bare wire
  ends on the motor end and for power cables for SINAMICS S120
  Combi Power Modules).

      MOTION-CONNECT connection systems
      Signal cables


    ■ Overview                                                                 ■ Application
                                                                                  DRIVE-CLiQ signal cables
                                                                                  DRIVE-CLiQ signal cables are used to connect components with
                                                                                  DRIVE-CLiQ connections which have a separate or external
                                                                                  24 V DC power supply.
                                                                                  MOTION-CONNECT DRIVE-CLiQ signal cables
                                                                                  MOTION-CONNECT DRIVE-CLiQ signal cables with 24 V DC
                                                                                  cores are used whenever components with DRIVE-CLiQ con-
                                                                                  nections must meet high requirements such as mechanical
                                                                                  stress and oil resistance, e.g. where a connection is made out-
                                                                                  side the cabinet between Power Modules/Motor Modules and
                                                                                  SIMOTICS S-1FK7/ SIMOTICS M-1PH8 motors with DRIVE-CLiQ
                                                                                  interface.
                                                                                  MOTION-CONNECT pre-assembled signal cables
                                                                                  MOTION-CONNECT pre-assembled signal cables are used
                                                                                  whenever motor encoders on motors without DRIVE-CLiQ inter-
                                                                                  face are connected to Sensor Modules.
      MOTION-CONNECT DRIVE-CLiQ signal cable with IP20/IP67 connector             Type of delivery for pre-assembled signal cables
      Signal cables are pre-assembled and are sold by the meter for               Pre-assembled signal cables are available in units of 10 cm
      the connection of a variety of components.                                  (3.94 in).
      The following different types of cable are available:                       Starting with 30 kg or 100 m (66.2 lb or 328 ft) or more, the ca-
      • DRIVE-CLiQ signal cables                                                  bles are supplied on cable drums; below 30 kg or 100 m, reels
      • MOTION-CONNECT DRIVE-CLiQ signal cables                                   are used instead of drums.
      • MOTION-CONNECT pre-assembled signal cables

                                                                                DRIVE-CLiQ cabinet bushing (RJ45)/DRIVE-CLiQ cabinet bushing (M12)

■ Overview                                                                                 ■ Overview




  DRIVE-CLiQ cabinet bushing for signal cables (RJ45)                                         DRIVE-CLiQ cabinet bushing for signal cables (M12)
  The DRIVE-CLiQ cabinet bushing (RJ45) provides the high IP67                                The DRIVE-CLiQ cabinet bushing (M12) provides the high IP67
  degree of protection for the appropriate MOTION-CONNECT                                     degree of protection for the appropriate MOTION-CONNECT
  DRIVE-CLiQ signal cables routed through openings in control                                 DRIVE-CLiQ signal cables routed through openings in control
  cabinets. The DRIVE-CLiQ cabinet bushing has IP54 degree of                                 cabinets. The DRIVE-CLiQ cabinet bushing (M12) has IP67 de-
  protection on the outside and IP20 on the inside of the control                             gree of protection at both ends and is designed as a socket with
  cabinet.                                                                                    internal thread on the outside of the cabinet and as pins with an
                                                                                              external thread on the inside of the cabinet.
                                                                                              Note:
                                                                                              The IP67 degree of protection is only achieved with the DRIVE-
                                                                                              CLiQ signal cables connected.

    ■ Overview                                                                         At the machine manufacturer
                                                                                       • Adaptation of SinuTrain to the specific machine

                                                                                    ■ Function
                                                                                       The SinuTrain offline programming station brings SINUMERIK
                                                                                       Operate to the PC to create realistic conditions, including ani-
                                                                                       mated machine control panels. This facilitates the easy transition
                                                                                       of know-how from a training situation into a practical environ-
                                                                                       ment. This powerful tool enables practice-oriented offline pro-
                                                                                       gramming on the PC based on the DIN 66025 programming lan-
                                                                                       guage, the ShopMill and ShopTurn options, type SINUMERIK
                                                                                       828D and 840D sl commands, and the direct transfer of CNC
                                                                                       programs to the CNC. Using SINUMERIK Operate and the orig-
                                                                                       inal SINUMERIK CNC kernel, all operating and programming op-
                                                                                       erations can be used and CNC programs executed.

                                                                                  Analyze MyMachine /SINUMERIK Tuning Center

■ Overview                                                           ■ Design
                                                                       The user interface of the Analyze MyMachine
                                                                       (AMM) /SINUMERIK Tuning Center (STC) is divided into the fol-
                                                                       lowing main sections:
                                                                       Describe your machine
                                                                       On the "Describe your machine" page, you can enter data for the
                                                                       machine that you would like to optimize. Some parameters, such
                                                                       as software limit switches and torque limit values, are automati-
                                                                       cally read when the application is connected to the machine.
                                                                       AMM /STC provides you with recommendations and settings
                                                                       based on the characteristics of your machine, as well as the
                                                                       planned applications and processes. The more detailed the in-
                                                                       formation you provide, the better the system will support you.
                                                                       Machine data can also be entered in offline mode before a con-
  Analyze MyMachine /SINUMERIK Tuning Center (AMM /STC)                nection to the machine is established.
  helps you to set up your machine by identifying optimum param-
  eters for the axes. AMM /STC guides you through the optimiza-
  tion process, helping you to carry out optimization so you can
  find the optimum settings. With AMM /STC, you can optimize
  your machine quickly and effectively.
  Analyze MyMachine /SINUMERIK Tuning Center supports the
  optimization of machines with the following profile:
  • One channel in SINUMERIK is supported.
  • One data set is optimized (servo data set 1 and the active
    drive data set).
  • Only metric units are supported, imperial units (such as inch)
    are not supported.
  • The focus is on path axes. Spindles can be optimized using
    the control loop tuning. In axis mode, acceleration tuning and
    jerk tuning are supported. The focus is not on the auxiliary       Axis selection
    axes, such as tool changers and handling axes; these are not       On the "Axis selection" page, you can select the axis that needs
    supported.                                                         to be optimized. Only one axis can be processed per optimiza-
                                                                       tion step. Optimize each axis separately.

      Hofmann Mess- und Auswucht GmbH & Co. KG - AB 9000 ring balancing system

    ■ Overview                                                              ■ Function
                                                                              • Automatic (active) balancing of rotors (e.g. grinding wheels,
                                                                                grinding spindles, turning chucks, fans) in one or two planes
                                                                                with imbalance monitoring
                                                                              • Active balancing during operation without machine shutdown
                                                                              • Ring-shaped balancing unit for efficient, space-saving inte-
                                                                                gration into the rotor
                                                                              • Very fast balancing even at high rotational speeds by electro-
                                                                                magnetic actuator and adaptive balancing process
                                                                              • Non-contact, wear-free transmission of actuator energy be-
                                                                                tween stator and balancing ring
                                                                              • Pre-balancing software for manual correction of basic unbal-
                                                                                ance - AB 9000 then only balances the new operational unbal-
                                                                                ances.
                                                                              • Balancing unit can be neutralized, e.g. for pre-balancing.
                                                                              • Indication of remaining balancing capacity
                                                                              • PC operating software

                                                                            ■ More information
                                                                              Hofmann Mess- und Auswuchttechnik GmbH & Co. KG
                                                                              Werner-von-Siemens-Straße 21
                                                                              64319 PFUNGSTADT
      AB 9000 ring balancing system                                           GERMANY
      The AB 9000 ring balancing system is based on a brilliantly sim-        Tel.: +49 6157 949-0
      ple concept. The vibrations generated on rotating systems due
      to imbalance are actively and quickly eliminated as the system          Email: info@hofmann-global.com
      rotates. Two balancing rotors are permanently mounted on the
                                                                              Internet: www.hofmann-global.com
      tool spindle via thin ring bearings. A fast, intelligent controller
      uses sensors to detect the imbalance in the spindle, calculates
      and adjusts the position of the two balancing rotors electromag-
      netically until they are ideally positioned to compensate the im-
      balance.

    ■ Benefits
      • Automatic (active) balancing of all kinds of rotors
      • Balancing during operation without machine shutdown
      • Implementation of test imbalance for the purpose of system
        identification
      • Generation of unbalance for acceptance tests

  VibroCut - oscillate
  VibroCut oscillate is a tool holder which causes the tool to oscil-
  late in a defined manner. It generates controlled vibrations to
  optimize the cutting process. By introducing precise oscillations,
  it ensures consistent chip breaking and improves machining
  efficiency.

■ Benefits
  • Reliable and robust chip breaking of every material
  • Reduced costs per item by elimination of rejects
  • Reliable process enables automatization
  • Prevention of operator accidents, such as cutting injuries from
    chipping
  • Reduction of process time by avoiding actual machine down-
    times
  • Optimization of processes

      VibroCut - ultrasonic

    ■ Overview                                                               ■ Function
                                                                               • Generation of ultrasound in the rotating tool holder
                                                                               • High-performance and integrated sensor for reliable ultra-
                                                                                 sonic performance
                                                                               • Ultrasonic equipment and control cabinet
                                                                               • HMI for ultrasonic visualization, process control and
                                                                                 calibration
                                                                               • Machine interface for the control

                                                                             ■ More information
                                                                               VibroCut GmbH
                                                                               Annaberger Str. 240
                                                                               09125 CHEMNITZ
                                                                               GERMANY
                                                                               Tel.: +49 371 335 660151 2054-0
                                                                               Email: info@vibrocut.de

      VibroCut - ultrasonic                                                    Internet: www.vibrocut.de/en

      VibroCut ultrasonic is an ultrasonic assistance that shifts existing
      process boundaries in drilling, deep hole drilling, and grinding.
      By minimizing friction, both tool wear and chip removal are
      improved.
      The minimized friction reduces both tool wear and improves chip
      removal.
      The reduction of process forces enables higher productivity,
      process safety and quality.

    ■ Benefits
      • Shifting process limits
        Ultrasound improves the machinability and enables the
        machining of materials that are difficult to cut
      • Increased productivity
        Reduced process forces enable higher cutting parameters,
        shorter machining times and an increased cutting rate
      • Improved process security
        Lower tool load, less surface cutting edge formation and
        optimized chip removal reduce the risk of tool failure
      • Reduced tool wear
        The reduced friction leads to a reduction in wear progression
        on the cutting tool.
      • Highest quality thanks to innovation
        Less burr formation and better bore quality, especially with
9       regard to straightness during deep hole drilling
      In our innovative systems, ultrasound is controlled in a defined
      manner using an integrated sensor. This ensures that identical
      conditions always prevail on the tool. This unique feature
      ensures a consistently high and reproducible quality that is
      currently unparalleled.

       Weight method
       The weight method uses the BOP, the daily price and the raw
10     material weight. In order to calculate the surcharge, the BOP
       must be subtracted from the daily price. The difference is then
       multiplied by the raw material weight.
       The BOP can be found in the table below using the number (1 to
       9) of the respective digit of the metal factor. The raw material
       weight can be found in the respective product descriptions.
       Percentage method
       Use of the percentage method is indicated by the letters A-Z at
       the respective digit of the metal factor.
